title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Gameplay Developer Launch Update
summary: Hear directly from the Gameplay team following the launch of EA SPORTS FC™ 27, covering early feedback and what we’re working on.

sections.title: Gameplay
sections.summary: Welcome to the Gameplay Developer Launch Update. First of all, the Gameplay Team is really excited to see everyone getting their hands on FC 27.

sections.title: What We’re Hearing From You
sections.summary: We wanted to share a few things that we’ve been monitoring, but it's important to acknowledge the most important piece of feedback we got from you last year. You asked us to give you more time to learn the game, to settle in, and to enjoy the experience…

sections.title: Fullbacks
sections.summary: One of the largest quantities of feedback we’ve received has been around fullbacks dropping too early and breaking the defensive line. We know this can be frustrating when it leads to a goal, so we’ve been doing some work to better understand what’s…

sections.title: Goals from Kick-off
sections.summary: We’ve also seen conversations about kick off goals happening more often. We’ve noticed some early movement in the data that we’re keeping an eye on to understand whether it develops into a wider trend.

sections.title: Passing and Interceptions
sections.summary: There has been some discussion around the balance between passing and interceptions. Our design goals are to reward the manual defender for getting into passing lanes, and we feel we’re achieving that.

sections.title: Shooting
sections.summary: Another topic that has come up is the balance between shooting types. We’ve seen feedback that low driven shots, particularly towards the near post, can be stronger than other options.

sections.title: What We’re Working On
sections.summary: While we aren’t changing anything that would impact core gameplay, we are looking into several issues related to fouls. For example, we’ve seen reports of referees not giving the correct outcome following certain challenges, which the team is currently…
